+    """Show follow state changes for both log widgets."""

+    Screen { background: $background; }
+    #logs { height: 1fr; padding: 1 2; }
+    .pane { width: 1fr; margin: 0 1; }
+    Label { color: $text-muted; margin-bottom: 1; }
+    Log, RichLog { border: round $primary; height: 1fr; }
+    .controls { height: 7; }
+    .actions { height: auto; }
+    .pane > Label { height: 2; }
+    Button { min-width: 12; margin: 1 1 0 0; }
+    #events { height: 8; margin: 0 3; border: round $secondary; }
+    #clear-events { margin: 0 3 1 3; }
+    """
+

+        """Build the two logs and their controls."""
+        yield Header()
+        with Horizontal(id="logs"):
+            with Vertical(classes="pane"):
+                yield Label("Plain text / scroll up to pause following")
+                yield Log(id="log", max_lines=200)
+                with Vertical(classes="controls"):
+                    with Horizontal(classes="actions"):
+                        yield Button("Follow Log", id="follow-log", variant="primary")
+                        yield Button("Append", id="append-log")
+            with Vertical(classes="pane"):
+                yield Label("Rich text / expanded entries adapt to width")
+                yield RichLog(id="rich", min_width=1, max_lines=200)
+                with Vertical(classes="controls"):
+                    with Horizontal(classes="actions"):
+                        yield Button("Follow Rich", id="follow-rich", variant="primary")
+                        yield Button("Append", id="append-rich")
+                    yield Button("Write expanded", id="write-expanded")
+        yield RichLog(id="events", min_width=1)
+        yield Button("Clear events", id="clear-events")
+        yield Footer()

+        """Populate enough entries to make scrolling possible."""
+        self.query_one("#log", Log).border_title = "Log / following"
+        self.query_one("#rich", RichLog).border_title = "RichLog / following"
+        self.query_one("#events", RichLog).border_title = "FollowChanged events"
+        self.query_one("#log", Log).write_lines(f"Log entry {n}" for n in range(60))
+        rich = self.query_one("#rich", RichLog)
+        for n in range(60):
+            rich.write(f"RichLog entry {n}")
+        rich.write(Text("Expanded to the right edge", justify="right"), expand=True)
+

+    def handle_button(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
+        """Apply the requested operation to its log."""
+        log = self.query_one("#log", Log)
+        rich = self.query_one("#rich", RichLog)
+        if event.button.id == "follow-log":
+            log.follow_end()
+        elif event.button.id == "follow-rich":
+            rich.follow_end()
+        elif event.button.id == "append-log":
+            log.write_line("Another ordinary Log entry")
+        elif event.button.id == "append-rich":
+            rich.write("Another ordinary RichLog entry")
+        elif event.button.id == "write-expanded":
+            rich.write(
+                Text("An expanded, right justified entry", justify="right"), expand=True
+            )
+        elif event.button.id == "clear-events":
+            self.query_one("#events", RichLog).clear()
+
+    @on(Log.FollowChanged)
+    @on(RichLog.FollowChanged)

+        """Record state transitions without logging the event log itself."""

+            self.query_one("#events", RichLog).write(
+                f"FollowChanged {event.widget.id}: {event.is_following_end} "
+                f"({event.scroll_y:g}/{event.max_scroll_y:g})"
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    RichLogFollowStateApp().run()

+"""Shared follow state for the log widgets."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from textual.message import Message
+from textual.scroll_view import ScrollView
+
+
+class FollowChanged(Message):
+    """The log's following state changed."""
+
+    def __init__(self, widget: LogScrollView, is_following_end: bool) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.widget = widget
+        """The log whose state changed."""
+        self.is_following_end = is_following_end
+        """Whether new output is being followed."""
+        self.scroll_y = widget.scroll_y
+        """Vertical scroll position when the state changed."""
+        self.max_scroll_y = widget.max_scroll_y
+        """Maximum vertical scroll position when the state changed."""
+
+    @property
+    def control(self) -> LogScrollView:
+        """The log whose state changed."""
+        return self.widget
+
+
+class LogScrollView(ScrollView):
+    """A scroll view which tracks whether the reader is following output."""
+
+    auto_scroll: bool
+    FollowChanged = FollowChanged
+    _is_following_end = True
+    _preserving_viewport = False
+    _following_requested = False
+
+    @property
+    def is_following_end(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether the log is following its newest entry."""
+        return self._is_following_end
+
+    def _set_following_end(self, following: bool) -> None:
+        """Publish only actual changes in following state."""
+        if following != self._is_following_end:
+            self._is_following_end = following
+            self.post_message(self.FollowChanged(self, following))
+
+    def watch_scroll_y(self, old_value: float, new_value: float) -> None:
+        # ScrollView also refreshes the viewport and updates the scrollbar.
+        super().watch_scroll_y(old_value, new_value)
+        if not self._preserving_viewport:
+            if (
+                self._following_requested
+                and self.scroll_target_y == self.max_scroll_y
+                and new_value >= old_value
+            ):
+                if self.is_vertical_scroll_end:
+                    self._following_requested = False
+                return
+            self._following_requested = False
+            self._set_following_end(self.is_vertical_scroll_end)
+
+    def follow_end(self, animate: bool = False) -> None:
+        """Scroll to the newest entry and resume following output.
+
+        Args:
+            animate: Animate the scroll to the end.
+        """
+        self._following_requested = animate
+        self.scroll_end(animate=animate, immediate=True, x_axis=False)
+        self._set_following_end(True)
+        self.call_after_refresh(self._follow_after_refresh, animate)
+
+    def _follow_after_refresh(self, animate: bool = False) -> None:
+        """Follow a changed layout only if the reader has not scrolled away."""
+        if self.is_following_end and not self.is_vertical_scrollbar_grabbed:
+            self.scroll_end(animate=animate, immediate=True, x_axis=False)
+
+    def _should_follow(self, scroll_end: bool | None) -> bool:
+        """Resolve the write override without interrupting a scrollbar drag."""
+        return not self.is_vertical_scrollbar_grabbed and (
+            self.auto_scroll and self.is_following_end
+            if scroll_end is None
+            else scroll_end
+        )
+
+    def _preserve_scroll(self, y: float) -> None:
+        """Move a viewport anchor after pruning without changing follow state."""
+        self._preserving_viewport = True
+        try:
+            self.scroll_to(y=max(0, y), animate=False, force=True)
+        finally:
+            self._preserving_viewport = False
+
+    def _finish_write(self, following: bool, animate: bool = False) -> None:
+        """Follow new output or keep the reader at the current position."""
+        if following:
+            self.follow_end(animate=animate)
+        elif self.is_following_end:
+            self._set_following_end(self.is_vertical_scroll_end)

+"""Regression tests for following, viewport stability, and responsive output."""
+
+import pytest
+from rich.text import Text
+
+from textual import on
+from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
+from textual.widgets import Log, RichLog
+
+
+class LogApp(App):
+    CSS = "Log, RichLog { width: 30; height: 8; }"
+
+    def __init__(self, widget):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.output = widget
+        self.changes = []
+
+    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
+        yield self.output
+
+    @on(Log.FollowChanged)
+    @on(RichLog.FollowChanged)
+    def changed(self, event):
+        self.changes.append(event)
+
+
+def append(log, count=1, *, scroll_end=None):
+    """Append numbered lines to either kind of log."""
+    for n in range(count):
+        if isinstance(log, Log):
+            log.write_line(f"entry {n}", scroll_end=scroll_end)
+        else:
+            log.write(f"entry {n}", scroll_end=scroll_end)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("widget_type", [Log, RichLog])
+async def test_follow_and_viewport(widget_type):
+    log = widget_type(max_lines=40)
+    app = LogApp(log)
+    async with app.run_test() as pilot:
+        append(log, 40)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.is_following_end
+        assert log.scroll_y == log.max_scroll_y
+        app.changes.clear()
+        log.scroll_to(y=12, animate=False)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert not log.is_following_end
+        assert log.vertical_scrollbar.position == 12
+        assert "entry 12" in log.render_line(0).text
+        assert [event.is_following_end for event in app.changes] == [False]
+        event = app.changes[0]
+        assert event.widget is event.control is log
+        assert event.scroll_y == 12
